part.text:
Fixed. The issue was in two rule matchers that checked the module name `"builtin"` instead of `"builtins"`:

- `crates/ruff_linter/src/rules/flake8_bandit/rules/exec_used.rs:39` (S102)
- `crates/ruff_linter/src/rules/flake8_use_pathlib/rules/replaceable_by_pathlib.rs:100` (PTH123)

Both now match `["" | "builtins", ...]`. Verified with `cargo test -p ruff_linter --lib`: all 59 `flake8_bandit` tests and all 17 `flake8_use_pathlib` tests pass, including the fixture cases covering `from builtins import exec/open` (flagged) and `from builtin import ...` (not flagged).
